subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We must try and incorporate positive thinking in our lives to ______ countless benefits it has to offer.
solution:
The correct answer is '**derive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses the importance of incorporating positive thinking.
 
• The verb should indicate gaining or obtaining benefits from positive thinking.
 
• "**Derive**" (व्युत्पन्न) fits well as it means to obtain something from a source, which aligns with the context of gaining benefits from positive thinking.
 
• Other options ("**ignore**", "**release**", "**contain**") do not fit the context of obtaining benefits from positive thinking.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

**Complete Sentence: ***We must try and incorporate positive thinking in our lives to **derive__ countless benefits it has to offer.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignore** (अवहेलना करना): Refuse to take notice of or acknowledge.

 
 
• **Example:** It is not wise to **ignore **the doctor's advice.
 
 
 
• **Release** (रिहा करना): Allow or enable to escape from confinement.
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to **release **the new product next month.
 
 
 
• **Contain** (संयम रखना): To hold or keep within limits.
 
 
• **Example:** The box can **contain **up to 5 kg of weight.
